tasks.gr12-economic-sectors-and-employment-t3: Topic: Economic sectors and employment. Cover the primary, secondary, tertiary and quaternary sectors, employment structure in South Africa, the formal and informal sectors, and how economic change affects jobs. Ask Grade 12 learners to classify activities or interpret employment trends.
tasks.gr12-agriculture-and-food-security-t3: Topic: Agriculture and food security. Cover factors affecting agriculture, commercial and subsistence farming, intensive and extensive land use, food security, drought, and sustainable farming strategies in South Africa. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain farming patterns or evaluate food-security interventions.
tasks.gr12-mining-industries-and-development-c: Topic: Mining, industries and development corridors. Cover the role of mining, raw materials, energy and transport in industrial location, environmental impacts, and the purpose of IDZs and SDIs in South Africa. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain industrial patterns or evaluate corridor-based development.
